gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.

gaps.sentence: I can't afford ___ another month abroad.
It's no use ___ about the weather.
gaps.explanation: it's no use + -ing: no use complaining.
deny + -ing or having + past participle: denied doing/having done. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: If you keep ___ like this, you'll exhaust yourself.
gaps.explanation: keep (+ on) is followed by -ing: keep working.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.
